purpose: Define explicit negative pruning as removal of selected/default capabilities without silently repairing the resulting dependency graph.

topics.name: Negative Pruning
topics.purpose: Define explicit negative pruning as removal of selected/default capabilities without silently repairing the resulting dependency graph.

semantics.rule: A prune directive removes an explicitly identified capability from the candidate boot set.
semantics.order_rule: Pruning occurs before final dependency validation/activation.
semantics.dependency_rule: If pruning breaks a required dependency, validation hard-fails unless the dependent capability is also explicitly pruned/changed.
semantics.no_repair_rule: Runtime never re-adds a pruned dependency automatically.
semantics.trace_rule: Final resolution records which capabilities were removed and why.

invariants.rule: Boot selection, pruning, dependency validation and activation are explicit; the runtime never silently enables missing dependencies.

references.purpose: Pruning modifies the explicit candidate set.

prose.summary: Define explicit negative pruning as removal of selected/default capabilities without silently repairing the resulting dependency graph.
